games.title: Noita Demake
games.description: A pocket wand-and-powder cave crawl: pixel liquids, fire, toxic sludge, gold, procedural biomes, enemies, spell slots, wand stats, flask pouring, Holy Mountain shops, and a final Sampo shard escape.

games.title: Cymatic
games.description: A playable Chladni plate: sand drains onto the nodal lines of a vibrating square, drawing each (m,n) resonance figure.

games.title: Hill Fort
games.description: A tiny fortress roguelite: start outside, dig into a hill, manage civilian and militia dwarves, hunt, fish, cook, craft, build workshops and stairs, and survive endless escalating raids.

games.title: Stone Ledger
games.description: A pocket world forge and legends viewer: value-noise continents, rivers, biomes, civ sites, roads, artifacts, wars, disasters, and a browseable event timeline.

games.title: Shell Lab
games.description: Elementary cellular automata grown into seashells — the textile cone really does wear Wolfram's Rule 30. Dial any rule 0-255, pick a specimen palette, and watch the shell draw itself tip to aperture.

games.title: Undervault
games.description: A room-by-room dungeon dive with depth lanes, torch-lit walls, and bump combat. Fight down eight strata for the Ember Crown.

games.title: Starlance
games.description: A wireframe space dogfighter with an FTL-style run: lasers overheat, missiles need a lock, credits drift out of every kill. Eight jumps, waystation shops, one carrier.

games.title: Color Mycelium
games.description: Branching hyphae paint slow rainbow threads.

games.title: Mycelium Garden
games.description: Hyphae forage for nutrients, fatten up, and fruit into mushrooms that puff spores.

games.title: Powder Box
games.description: A falling-sand sandbox: sand, water, walls, plants, and fire.

games.title: Terrarium
games.description: A glass jar of tiny leaf-headed pips that trot, hop, and float. Drop berries, watch eggs hatch, fireflies at night.

games.title: Physarum
games.description: A slime mold of 320 blind agents builds veiny transport networks out of nothing.

games.title: Hex Bloom
games.description: Snowflake crystals bloom on a hexagonal grid via the Ulam-Warburton rule.

games.title: Oculus Garden
games.description: A moonlit bed of eye-stalks that sway, track your cursor, and get shy if you stare.

games.title: Lava Lamp
games.description: Six metaball blobs of goo melt into each other, kept circulating by heat.

games.title: Koi Pond
games.description: Four koi drift as flexing chains of circles, nosing toward ripples. Tap the water and watch them come.
